SELECT 
    p.name_first,
    p.name_last
FROM 
    player p
JOIN 
    team t ON p.player_id = t.team_id
JOIN 
    salary s ON t.team_id = s.team_id
JOIN 
    team_franchise tf ON t.team_id = tf.team_id
WHERE 
    s.year IN (2005, 2007)
    AND t.league_id = 'Washington Nationals'
    AND t.rank = 1
